name: sort-filter
description: Sort and filter Excel ranges in place

tools.name: sort_filter
tools.description: Sort or AutoFilter a range in Excel (never send the table body to the model). action: sort|filter|clearFilter. column may be a letter (B), 1-based index, or header (金额). filterBy operators: greaterThan|greaterThanOrEqual|lessThan|lessThanOrEqual|equals|notEqual|contains|notContains|beginsWith|endsWith|blanks|nonBlanks|between (value2 for between). Multiple filterBy entries are AND. sortBy: [{column, order:'ascending'|'descending'}].
